note: Rolling median of individual completed eBay sales of sealed One Piece booster boxes, sampled every 7 days and dated by SALE date (not collection date). The averaging window is chosen per series (28-56 days) so that each point rests on roughly 12 sales, because sales volume differs more than tenfold between sets; each series records the window it used. Rebuilt from data/box-sold-ledger.json on every run, so a change in how listings are collected cannot show up as a price move. Windows with fewer than 6 sales are omitted rather than estimated. Prices are per box in USD. A monthly view (median of every sale within each calendar month, minimum 6 sales) is included alongside, because sets with wide dispersion between individual sales are steadier when grouped by month.
